intent: A compact 24px icon-only button for toolbar and panel actions.
guidance: Reach for IconButton whenever an action is represented by a glyph alone — panel headers, toolbars, the composer. It carries its accessible name as both the aria-label and the hover tooltip, so a sighted user can always learn what a glyph does (Composa#661). Pass `active` for a toggle: it paints the selected ground and sets aria-pressed; leave it off for a plain action. For a connected row of these use IconButtonRow, and for a section right-action that turns an accent 'on' glyph use PanelActionBtn — this is the standalone one.
use_when: A toolbar or panel action shown as a glyph alone (Upload, Play, New chat).
A single icon toggle that reflects on/off (pass `active`).
dont_use_when: The action needs a visible text label — use Button.
Several related icon toggles form one connected control — use IconButtonRow.

rules.do: Import the shared IconButton for a glyph-only action or toggle.
rules.dont: Re-implement a private icon-button component in a panel or toolbar instead of importing the shared one.

rules.do: Give every IconButton a `label` — it is both the aria-label and the tooltip.
rules.dont: Ship an icon-only button with no accessible name.

a11y.name: the `label` prop supplies both aria-label and the tooltip
a11y.pressed: a toggle sets aria-pressed from `active`; a plain action leaves it unset
a11y.focus: focus-visible ring bound to the focus-ring token; disabled is removed from the tab order.
